headline: Aragonese farm organizations call for structural measures in the face of rising production costs
summary: Aragon farm organizations ARAGA, ASAJA, UAGA-COAG and UPA gathered in Zaragoza outside the Government Delegation. They called for structural measures amid rising production costs, especially diesel and fertilizers.
why: Diesel and fertilizer are major input costs for farming, so sustained price rises squeeze farm margins and can feed through to food prices.
